summary: Iteration 22 backend testing — 24/24 tests passed (100%). Validated AdMob SSV signed-callback endpoint GET /api/system/rewarded/ssv and Phase-4 roadmap-speedup changes. Unit-tested admob_ssv module: parse_custom_data('uid:abc|endpoint:tutor_chat')={'uid':'abc','endpoint':'tutor_chat'}, empty string=={}, None-safe, malformed tokens skipped; _canonical_message correctly strips '&signature=...' substring and returns None when no signature marker present. Live-HTTP error paths on /api/system/rewarded/ssv verified: no params → 400 ssv_missing_params, missing key_id → 400, missing transaction_id → 400, bogus signature with all params → 400 ssv_signature_invalid (real Google verifier keys rejected the fake sig as expected). Happy-path tests run in-process via httpx.ASGITransport with admob_ssv.verify_ssv monkeypatched to return True: (1) valid call grants reward, returns {ok:true,result:{...}}, and persists a doc in Mongo rewarded_ssv with correct uid/endpoint/reward_amount; (2) same transaction_id called twice → second call returns {ok:true, reason:'already_processed'} and does NOT re-grant; (3) empty custom_data + user_id query param → falls back correctly and grants to that uid; (4) empty custom_data + no user_id → 400 ssv_missing_uid. POST /api/system/rewarded/claim regression: 401 user_id_required, premium_no_bonus_needed, first-of-day free grant works. POST /api/ai/roadmap/generate returned exactly 30 days with non-empty meta.summary & meta.goal_title, each day has int day, non-empty title/focus, tasks list ≤5, string tip — new 6x5-chunk fan-out is producing complete roadmaps under 20s. Regression pass on /api/system/pricing, /api/system/quota, /api/system/subscription/verify (fallback trust mode), /api/legal/privacy, /api/legal/data-deletion — all 200 OK, identical to iteration_21.
critical_code_review_comments: admob_ssv._canonical_message uses substring rule `qs[:idx-1]` which assumes signature is NEVER the first param. If Google ever changes ordering and puts signature first, the function would return an empty string and verification would silently fail (returns False from verify_ssv). Google's spec guarantees signature is last, so low risk, but a defensive check (`if idx < 1: return None`) would harden it. Current code returns None when idx<=0 which is fine, but a single `signature=xyz` string returns None due to idx==0 — acceptable.

system_routes.rewarded_ssv writes to Mongo AFTER granting the bonus. If Mongo write fails, the user got the bonus but no dedupe record was persisted, so Google's retry (Google retries on non-200) would double-grant. Consider inserting the dedupe doc BEFORE grant, or wrapping both in a transaction. For an idempotent grant_rewarded_bonus this is minor; if grant becomes non-idempotent, this becomes a real bug.
admob_ssv._KEYS_CACHE is process-local; each backend worker fetches its own copy. Fine for 24h TTL, but if Google rotates a key, up to `worker_count * key_id_miss` extra fetches. Acceptable.

ai_routes.roadmap_generate uses asyncio.gather(chunks_gather, meta_task) — if meta_task raises, the chunks are cancelled. Consider return_exceptions=True on the outer gather too, with fallback strings for summary/goal_title if meta fails. Currently a Claude Haiku failure would 500 the whole roadmap even if all 6 Gemini chunks succeeded.

system_routes uses `_db = AsyncIOMotorClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL'])[os.environ['DB_NAME']]` at module import — this binds the client to the import-time event loop, which caused the 'Event loop is closed' error the first run of the pytest-asyncio tests until loop_scope='module' was set. This is a test-only artefact (production has one loop), but future test authors will hit it — worth a comment in the module.
test_credentials: None — per-test unique UUIDs used for X-User-Id.
seed_data_creation: MongoDB rewarded_ssv collection: transaction_ids prefixed tx-happy-*, tx-dedupe-*, tx-uf-*. Idempotent on transaction_id (dedupe). Bonus_events / usage counters incremented for uids qa-ssv-happy-*, qa-ssv-dedupe-*, qa-ssv-uidfallback-*, qa-rc-grant-*, qa-roadmap-*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 SSV + roadmap speedup are green. Happy-path tests rely on pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 (installed this iteration) with `loop_scope='module'` because system_routes._db is bound to the import-time event loop — do NOT remove that annotation or the Motor calls will hit 'Event loop is closed'. Real Google ECDSA signature verification is NOT covered (unforgeable in tests); when integrating a real AdMob sandbox, hit the endpoint from a real staging AdMob ad unit and confirm 200. For roadmap tests, if the daily budget guard trips (503), the test skips instead of failing — reset via /api/system/admin-toggle {daily_budget_inr: <n>, force_disabled:false} with X-Admin-Email header.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional failures. One test-infra hiccup: motor's AsyncIOMotorClient module-level instantiation in system_routes binds to first event loop; resolved by setting @pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope='module') on TestSsvHappyPath.
